target: acceptance 7 — the untrusted-output class is a SECURITY class and must fire with guards disabled. Checked structurally by line position, not by keywords: the blind review moved the whole paragraph inside the guards-gated section and a keyword-proximity assertion did not notice.
cmd: f="$PLUGIN_ROOT/agents/reviewer.md"; u=$(grep -n -m1 "Acted-upon untrusted output" "$f" | cut -d: -f1); g=$(grep -n -m1 "guards.enabled" "$f" | cut -d: -f1); say=$(grep -A5 -m1 "Acted-upon untrusted output" "$f" | tr "\n" " " | tr -s " " | grep -ci "regardless of the .guards. flag\|NOT gated by .guards."); printf '{"untrustedLine":%s,"guardsLine":%s,"saysUnconditional":%s}' "${u:-0}" "${g:-0}" "$say"
